project.name: Boom Bap Experimental Emotional Club Energy

arrangement.notes: Arrangement features micro chops, phrase chops, reverse chops, vocal chops, and stutter chops distributed across relevant channels for experimental emotional boom bap with club energy.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Increase energy with vocal chops and stutter chops introduction

event_markers.label: Bridge Vocal Effect
event_markers.reason: Add experimental reverse chops and phrase chops for dynamic bridge

micro_chops.description: Layer of micro chopping samples for rhythmic texture

phrase_chops.description: Arrangement channel using phrase chopping technique

reverse_chops.description: Channel dedicated to reversed chopped samples

stutter_chops.description: Channel implementing stutter effects on chopped samples

sound_intent.overall_mood: emotional with a club energy vibe
sound_intent.texture: Fragmented chops layered to create rhythmic complexity

routing_intent.micro_chops: dry signal routed to drums and fx buses
routing_intent.phrase_chops: processed with delay and routed to chords and melody
routing_intent.reverse_chops: wet signal routed mainly to fx and vocal lanes
routing_intent.vocal_chops: clean and rhythmic vocal samples routed to vocal lane
routing_intent.stutter_chops: effect lanes processed for rhythmic stutter applied to drums and vocals

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic backbone utilizing chops with stutter effects
track_roles.bass: Supportive low end complementing rhythmic chops
track_roles.melody: Textural melodic layers using chopped samples
track_roles.fx: Atmospheric and transitional effects with reverse and stutter chops

designer_intent.goal: Create an experimental emotional boom bap arrangement that balances texture and energy for club play, using multiple sample chopping techniques distinctly routed and layered.

presetor_intent.task: Apply preset chains emphasizing clarity on chops, spatial effects on reverse chops, and dynamic modulation on stutter chops.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate experimental drum patterns using micro chops and stutter chops emphasizing rhythmic complexity and club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Compose supportive bass lines that lock with drum chops and maintain emotional depth.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop chord progressions utilizing phrase chops to add harmonic texture in an emotional context.

melody_generator.brief: Create textural melodic layers using chopped samples, focusing on expressive phrasing.

ai_designer.brief: Design arrangement structure integrating sample chopping variations while maintaining smooth flow and energetic dynamics.

presetor.brief: Apply and optimize effect presets to highlight micro chops, reverse chops, and vocal chops distinctly across tracks.

songgps.brief: Monitor energy curve and section transitions to ensure consistent club energy with emotional impact.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance and process unprocessed channel audio emphasizing clarity and separation for chopped sample layers.
